reuse.why: Extends the existing getMonthActionCategories helper that every month-wide action (copyPreviousMonth included) already uses, so no action needed touching.

duplication.why: The #fixed rule is written once (a regex plus a group-id lookup) and applied in the single selection helper.

placement.why: The exclusion lives in the shared category-selection helper in budget/actions.ts, the layer that already holds the other month-wide exclusions.

scope.why: Helper extension, its comment and one focused test; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Small, named, documented and covered by a test including the near-miss tag and category-note cases; any further rule changes in the same place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions go through getMonthActionCategories.

one_place.where: getMonthActionCategories / getFixedGroupIds in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the 3/6/12-month averages.
